description: Backend-specific rules for Spring Boot development

rules.description: Focus on Java/Spring Boot code in backend/ directory
rules.instruction: Work primarily in backend/src/main/java and backend/src/main/resources directories.
Add dependencies to pom.xml. Use existing dependency versions when possible. Run mvn validate after changes.
Use constructor injection. Leverage Spring Boot auto-configuration. Follow Spring coding conventions.
Use proper HTTP methods and status codes. Follow RESTful URL patterns. Return consistent error formats.

rules.description: Write unit tests with JUnit and Mockito
rules.instruction: Write tests for all new code. Use Mockito for mocking. Aim for >80% coverage. Place tests in src/test/java.

rules.description: Follow the existing package structure: com.guitartutorial.backend.*
rules.instruction: Organize code by feature within the existing package hierarchy. Keep related classes together.
Use Flyway migrations. Name migrations with version prefix. Write reversible migrations when possible.
